Maria Chen: PTAL — addressed the comments on PR #4523. Split into two commits (refactor + bugfix), added a quick smoke script and updated CHANGELOG. I'd like to merge before Thu EOD if we can get a 2nd approver. Rebased onto main. Smoke command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --quick`
Sam Patel: Quick skim — LGTM overall. Left one nit about `timeout_ms` naming and a log message that prints raw obj.
Maria Chen: Thanks — pushed a rename commit to `timeout` (0f3a9b). Updated the log to avoid printing secret fields. PTAL again.
Leo Gomez: Couple tiny parsing nits in parser.go, left inline comments. Not blocking. LGTM after fixes.
infra-bot: CI passed: build · unit · smoke. Smoke script executed. https://ci.redwood/4523/build/1234 :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: I can give a second approve but we need a canary slot. @ops-scheduler any availability?
ops-scheduler: Friday 09:00–11:00 PT has a free canary window, or Monday 08:00–10:00 PT. Which would you prefer?
Maria Chen: Friday AM works for us. I'll hold off merging and wait for the Friday slot. Thanks! :pray:
Sam Patel: One more ask — rebase once more to pick up the security patch on main (merged ~1769970000). There might be a tiny conflict in vendor/crypto.
Maria Chen: Rebased and force-pushed (1769999996), fixed the vendor conflict. CI re-run is green.
deploy-bot: Canary reserved for PR #4523 on 2025-02-14 09:00 PT by @Maria Chen.
Maria Chen: Great — thanks everyone. I'll merge after the canary smoke passes. :rocket:
